meta.dataset: FAO-56 crop root-zone depletion fractions for no stress
meta.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8, Table 22
meta.verificationStatus: FAO_REFERENCE_VALUES; crop and climate conditions apply
meta.notes: p values are tabulated for ETc about 5 mm/day and may be adjusted by FAO-56 for ETc. Measured mode uses farmer-entered root-zone moisture. Estimated mode starts from a confirmed date at field capacity. The lower bound of FAO maximum effective root-depth ranges is used only for mid- and late-season scheduling estimates when roots are established; for early stages or field-specific conditions, provide measured root depth.
